THREE FORMS, THREE PROBLEMS

Every day people write their information on forms. And every day there are small problems. Here are three of them.

FORM ONE. A man writes Smith in the box for First name and John in the box for Surname. Now the computer says his name is Smith John. His letters come with the wrong name on them. He is not happy.

FORM TWO. A woman says her email address on the phone: maria dot lopez at fastmail dot com. The man writes maria.lopez@fasmail.com. One letter is not there. Maria waits for the email. The email never comes.

FORM THREE. A student says her phone number very fast. The teacher writes it down. Later the teacher calls the number and a man answers. He is not a student. He is a taxi driver in another city.

So: say it slowly, spell it, and read it again. Three seconds now, or three days later.

Language · asking for and giving information

TUSHUNTIRISH — WHAT'S YOUR…?

Savollarning hammasi bir xil shaklda. What's your + surname? / address? / phone number? / email address? Toʻrt savol, bitta qolip. Qolipni oʻrgansangiz, toʻrttasini ham bilasiz.

Javob esa doim IT'S. I'm emas, He's emas, They're emas. Maʼlumot — bu narsa, narsa esa it.

✓ What's your surname? — It's Robinson. · What's your address? — It's 7 King Street.

✓ What's your phone number? — It's 0124 352738. · What's your email address? — It's chris@powermail.com.

Telefon raqami koʻp sonlarga oʻxshaydi, lekin u BITTA raqam. Shuning uchun It's, hech qachon They're emas. Manzil ham shunday: koʻp soʻz, lekin bitta manzil.

DIQQAT — KOʻP UCHRAYDIGAN XATOLAR

1 I'M emas. ✗ What's your surname? — I'm Robinson. → ✓ It's Robinson. I'm — siz haqingizda, ismingiz haqida emas.

2 THEY'RE emas. ✗ It's my phone number — they're 0124 352738. → ✓ It's 0124 352738.

3 HE'S emas. ✗ What's your email address? — He's chris@… → ✓ It's chris@…

4 HOW IS emas, WHAT'S deng. ✗ How is your name? → ✓ What's your name? how ni faqat imlo uchun ishlating: How do you spell that?

The alphabet · saying it and spelling with it

TUSHUNTIRISH — ALIFBO

Siz 26 ta harfni emas, 7 ta tovushni oʻrganasiz. Har bir harf yetti guruhdan biriga kiradi va guruh ichidagi harflar ohangdosh.

/eɪ/ (day dagi kabi) A H J K

/iː/ (see dagi kabi) B C D E G P T V

/e/ (ten dagi kabi) F L M N S X Z

/aɪ/ (my dagi kabi) I Y · /əʊ/ (no dagi kabi) O

/uː/ (you dagi kabi) Q U W · /ɑː/ (car dagi kabi) R

Xavflilari har xil guruhda. E va I · G va J · A va R. Har bir juftlikni hozir ikki marta ovoz chiqarib ayting.

Everyday English · numbers, addresses, intonation

TUSHUNTIRISH — RAQAMLAR, MANZILLAR

Telefon raqamlari: har bir raqamni alohida ayting. 0124 352738 — oh - one - two - four …, hech qachon one hundred and twenty-four emas.

Telefon raqamida 0 — OH, zero ham, nought ham emas. · Ikkita bir xil raqam = DOUBLE. 55 — double five.

Email manzillar: @ — AT, . — DOT. chris@powermail.com — chris at powermail dot com.

Belgilarning ham nomi bor. _ — underscore · - — dash yoki hyphen · bosh harf — capital A.

Manzillar: ingliz tilida raqam oldin keladi. 7 King Street, King Street 7 emas. Keyin shahar, keyin davlat.

TALAFFUZ — SAVOL OXIRIDAGI OVOZ

Soʻroq soʻzli savolda ovoz PASAYADI. What's your name? ↘ · How do you spell that? ↘ what soʻzining oʻzi tinglovchiga bu savol ekanini aytadi, shuning uchun ovoz pasaya oladi.

Soʻroq soʻzi yoʻq savolda ovoz KOʻTARILADI. Is that right? ↗ · Sorry? ↗ · Taylor? ↗ Bu yerda savol ekanini faqat ovoz bildiradi, shuning uchun u koʻtarilishi shart.

Bu bezak emas. Pasayuvchi Sorry. — „kechirasiz“ degani. Koʻtariluvchi Sorry? — „qayta ayting“ degani. Bir soʻz, ikki maʼno — hammasini ovoz qiladi.
